market.rules_primary: If Alex Bregman records 1+ home runs in Chicago C vs Cincinnati professional baseball game originally scheduled for Sep 18, 2026 at 6:40 PM EDT, then the market resolves to Yes.
market.rules_secondary:
Player Participation & Settlement Criteria
If Alex Bregman is scratched or not included in the starting lineup, the market will resolve to the fair market price.
If Alex Bregman starts the game but does not record a plate appearance, the market will resolve to the fair market price.
If Alex Bregman is not in the starting lineup but later enters the game, the market will resolve to the fair market price, pinch hit at bats will not count towards the market.
If Alex Bregman is in the starting lineup and records at least one plate appearance the market will settle based on home runs recorded.
